Yasuo.identity: High-mobility crit samurai who threads dashes through minion waves and converts knockups into lethal Last Breath ultimates.
Yasuo.winCondition: Reach your 2-item 100% critical strike threshold, group around knockup allies, and execute backliners with R.
powerSpikes: Blade of the Ruined King / Kraken
Yasuo.skillMaxReason: Max Q first for core damage and tornado poke, then max E to reduce dash static cooldown on targets.
Yasuo.bootsWhy: Essential early purchase to cap Steel Tempest (Q) cooldown and cast time.
Yasuo.keystoneTldr: Attacking champions stacks attack speed and grants bonus attack range.
Yasuo.keystoneWhy: Accelerates your Q cooldown to its absolute minimum and allows relentless melee stickiness.

Yone.identity: Spirit dual-wielder with relentless dive potential via Soul Unbound (E) and devastating AoE teamfight crowd control.
Yone.winCondition: Farm safely to 2 items, then launch E flank angles to engage enemy carries with Fate Sealed (R).
Yone.skillMaxReason: Max Q for constant damage poke, then E to ramp up true-damage snapback execute.
Yone.bootsWhy: Caps Q and W cooldowns and cast times for fluid combo execution.
Yone.keystoneTldr: Attacking champions stacks attack speed and bonus range.
Yone.keystoneWhy: Dramatically accelerates early trading power and Q cooldown resets.

Ezreal.identity: Slippery prodigal explorer who snipes skillshots from maximum range and repositions safely with Arcane Shift (E).
Ezreal.winCondition: Hit your Muramana + Trinity Force two-item spike, poke enemies down before dragon/baron fights, and clean up.
Ezreal.skillMaxReason: Max Q first for primary damage and cooldown refund on hit, then E for safe blink cooldown.
Ezreal.bootsWhy: Provides essential ability haste to keep Mystic Shot spammable without delays.
Ezreal.keystoneTldr: Hitting 3 consecutive attacks/spells exposes the target for bonus damage.
Ezreal.keystoneWhy: Easily proc'd via Auto-Q-Auto to amplify both your poke and your team's follow-up damage.

Aatrox.identity: Darkin Blade warrior who dominates mid-range melee fights with sweet-spot knockups and massive missing-health healing resets.
Aatrox.winCondition: Win skirmishes with World Ender (R) active, chain sweet-spot Qs on clumped targets, and sustain through enemy focus.
Aatrox.skillMaxReason: Max Q for damage and sweet-spot multipliers, then E to lower dash cooldown for spacing.
Aatrox.bootsWhy: Mitigates early physical trading damage in top lane brawls.
Aatrox.keystoneTldr: Spells and attacks stack bonus AD and grant healing at max stacks.
Aatrox.keystoneWhy: Multiplies Aatrox's already formidable healing throughput during extended teamfights.

LeeSin.identity: The Blind Monk excels at high-tempo early ganks, objective steals, and game-changing Dragon's Rage (R) Insec kicks.
LeeSin.winCondition: Accelerate the early game through jungle invades, secure early dragons, and kick enemy carries into your team.
LeeSin.skillMaxReason: Max Q for execute damage and mobility, then W for shielding and omnivamp sustain.
LeeSin.bootsWhy: Reduces smite and ability cooldowns for continuous gank uptime.
LeeSin.keystoneTldr: Attacks and spells stack adaptive force and heal at full stacks.
LeeSin.keystoneWhy: Provides sustained dueling power against enemy junglers in river brawls.

Zed.identity: Shadow assassin who slips behind enemy lines, swaps through shadows, and leaves a fatal Death Mark.
Zed.winCondition: Snowball through mid lane roams, pressure side lanes, and delete enemy backline carries before teamfights ignite.
Zed.skillMaxReason: Max Q for primary shuriken burst and waveclear, then E for shadow spin damage.
Zed.bootsWhy: Fast ability haste to cycle shadow cooldowns and energy abilities repeatedly.
Zed.keystoneTldr: Hitting 3 spells or attacks discharges burst damage.
Zed.keystoneWhy: Guarantees your W-E-Q combo deletes squishy mid laners.

Lux.identity: Long-range demacian light mage capable of locking targets down with Light Binding and vaporizing them with Final Spark.
Lux.winCondition: Siege from outside enemy vision, land binding picks on squishies, and obliterate them with your laser combo.
Lux.skillMaxReason: Max E first for fast waveclear and poke, then Q for binding damage and cooldown.
Lux.bootsWhy: Flat magic penetration amplifies early burst against squishy targets.
Lux.keystoneTldr: Damaging a champion hurls a comet to their location.
Lux.keystoneWhy: Synergizes with E's slow to guarantee comet hits for relentless lane poke.

Nautilus.identity: The Titan of the Depths packs the heaviest crowd-control kit in League, locking down high-priority targets with point-blank depth charges.
Nautilus.winCondition: Find aggressive level 2 hook engages in bot lane, then lock down enemy hypercarries in 5v5 teamfights.
Nautilus.skillMaxReason: Max Q for hook cooldown reduction, then W for shield durability.
Nautilus.bootsWhy: Enables rapid map roams to mid lane and objective warding.
Nautilus.keystoneTldr: Immobilizing an enemy grants huge bonus Armor/MR, then explodes.
Nautilus.keystoneWhy: Ensures you survive your all-in hook dive without getting focused down.

Lulu.identity: The Fae Sorceress protects hypercarries with thick shields, polymorphs aggressive divers, and turns allies giant with Wild Growth.
Lulu.winCondition: Attach yourself to your fed hypercarry, polymorph anyone diving them, and amplify their DPS with Help, Pix!.
Lulu.skillMaxReason: Max E first for shield capacity, then W to increase polymorph disable duration.
Lulu.bootsWhy: Lowers shield and summoner spell cooldowns for frequent peels.
Lulu.keystoneTldr: Attacks send Aery to damage enemies; spells shield allies.
Lulu.keystoneWhy: Provides continuous lane poke and bolsters your E shielding value.

Sylas.identity: Rebellious mage bruiser who steals game-winning ultimates and brawls endlessly with missing-health Kingslayer heals.
Sylas.winCondition: Steal high-impact teamfight ultimates (Malphite, Amumu, Leona) and dive backline carries in skirmishes.
Sylas.skillMaxReason: Max W for huge burst damage and clutch healing, then E for dash burst and cooldown.
Sylas.bootsWhy: Increases spell pen to execute targets in a single Kingslayer rotation.
Sylas.keystoneTldr: Attacks and abilities stack adaptive force and heal at max stacks.
Sylas.keystoneWhy: Synergizes perfectly with Sylas's passive auto attacks between spell weaves.

Vayne.identity: The Night Hunter shreds through any tank with % max health true damage Silver Bolts while tumbling invisibly in teamfights.
Vayne.winCondition: Survive early lane phase, achieve your 2-item on-hit spike, and kite front-to-back in teamfights.
powerSpikes: Blade of the Ruined King Spike
Vayne.skillMaxReason: Max W for maximum % true damage shred, then Q for lower tumble cooldown.
Vayne.bootsWhy: Essential attack speed to trigger 3-hit Silver Bolt procs rapidly.
Vayne.keystoneTldr: Attacking champions ramps attack speed and range.
Vayne.keystoneWhy: Allows kiting from safe distances while maximizing Silver Bolt proc rate.

KaiSa.identity: Daughter of the Void with adaptive evolutions who repositions into backlines with Killer Instinct (R) to assassinate carries.
KaiSa.winCondition: Evolve Q (Q-evolve damage spike), then burst down isolated targets and dive backlines.
KaiSa.skillMaxReason: Max Q first for isolated missile burst and quick evolution, then E for attack speed and stealth.
KaiSa.bootsWhy: Provides the essential attack speed required to trigger E evolution stealth.
KaiSa.keystoneTldr: 3 hits expose the enemy for bonus damage.
KaiSa.keystoneWhy: Stacks rapidly with Plasma passives for lethal 3-hit burst trades.
